articles.summary: ~ Positioned to Advance Innovation and Growth in Support of Customers and Patients ~ PLANO, Texas, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Integer Holdings Corporation (NYSE: ITGR) (Integer or the Company), a leading global medical device contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), today announced the completion of its acquisition by an affiliate of investment funds managed by KKR, a leading global investment firm, in a transaction valued at an enterprise value of approximately $5.7 billion (the Transaction). The Transaction was announced on August 3, 2026, and was approved by Integer stockholders on October 21, 2026. Under the terms of the Transaction, Integer stockholders will receive $127 per share in cash. With the completion of the Transaction, Integers common stock has ceased trading and will no longer be listed on the New York Stock Exchange. Today marks an exciting new chapter for Integer, our associates,
articles.title: Integer Announces Completion of Acquisition by KKR
